introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-001
items.detail: Design a secure university remote access management system that controls off-campus access to internal university applications, servers, research systems, and administrative resources.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: Authorized administrators should be able to define remote-access permissions, approve or revoke access for users, review active remote sessions, and terminate suspicious sessions.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-003
items.detail: The system should authenticate users before access is granted, enforce role-based access restrictions, detect repeated failed login attempts and unauthorized access attempts, generate security alerts, and maintain audit logs of remote access activity and administrator actions.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: The platform should provide a centralized dashboard, integrate with existing university identity services, support multiple campus locations, and remain secure, reliable, scalable, and manageable.

open_issues: What conditions define repeated authentication failures?
What conditions define unauthorized access attempts?

functional.applicability_reason: Independent source obligations; unspecified choices remain TBD.

requirements.title: control off-campus access to internal university applications, servers, research systems, and administrative resources
requirements.statement: The system shall control off-campus access to internal university applications, servers, research systems, and administrative resources.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system evaluates a user's off-campus access request against defined policies
acceptance_criteria.when: the system initiates an access control decision for a university application, server, research system, or administrative resource
acceptance_criteria.then: the system returns a response indicating whether the request is permitted or denied based on configured rules and context
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: allow Authorized administrators to define remote-access permissions
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Authorized administrators to define remote-access permissions.

acceptance_criteria.given: An authorized administrator reviews the remote-access policy definition for a named user.
acceptance_criteria.when: The administrator initiates a request to define permissions for that user.
acceptance_criteria.then: The requested policy definition is returned and available for examination in the system interface.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: allow Authorized administrators to approve or revoke access for users
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Authorized administrators to approve or revoke access for users.

acceptance_criteria.given: An authorized administrator receives a request to approve or revoke access for a named user.
acceptance_criteria.when: The administrator approves that request through the defined workflow.
acceptance_criteria.then: The approval decision is recorded and reflected in the system state within one second of the action completion.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: allow Authorized administrators to review active remote sessions
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Authorized administrators to review active remote sessions.

acceptance_criteria.given: An authorized administrator requests a review of active remote sessions for a named user.
acceptance_criteria.when: The administrator submits a request to retrieve those sessions via the defined interface.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system returns the list of active sessions and their associated metadata for examination.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: allow Authorized administrators to terminate suspicious sessions
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Authorized administrators to terminate suspicious sessions.

acceptance_criteria.given: An authorized administrator identifies a suspicious session for a named user.
acceptance_criteria.when: The administrator requests termination of that session through the defined interface.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system confirms the session has been terminated and no further activity is observed from that session within five seconds of the request completion.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: authenticate users before access is granted
requirements.statement: The system shall authenticate users before access is granted.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system receives a principal identity from a controlled identity fixture
acceptance_criteria.when: the system initiates authentication for the principal
acceptance_criteria.then: authentication is accepted or rejected based on the fixture's defined credentials
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: enforce role-based access restrictions
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce role-based access restrictions.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system receives a role or policy permission fixture
acceptance_criteria.when: the system evaluates access based on that role or policy
acceptance_criteria.then: access is allowed or denied in accordance with the fixture's defined permissions
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: detect repeated failed login attempts
requirements.statement: The system shall detect repeated failed login attempts.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system observes a controlled sequence of failed login attempts
acceptance_criteria.when: the system processes the repeated authentication failures
acceptance_criteria.then: the condition of repeated failed attempts is identified by the system
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

unresolved_decisions: What conditions define repeated authentication failures?

requirements.title: detect unauthorized access attempts
requirements.statement: The system shall detect unauthorized access attempts.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system receives a controlled access attempt from an unauthorized source
acceptance_criteria.when: the system evaluates the origin and permissions of the request
acceptance_criteria.then: the condition of unauthorized access is identified by the system
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

unresolved_decisions: What conditions define unauthorized access attempts?

requirements.title: generate security alerts
requirements.statement: The system shall generate security alerts.

acceptance_criteria.given: a controlled alert condition is triggered by system activity
acceptance_criteria.when: the system detects and responds to the event
acceptance_criteria.then: an alert exists in the designated monitoring channel
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the inspection record

requirements.title: maintain audit logs of remote access activity and administrator actions
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain audit logs of remote access activity and administrator actions.

acceptance_criteria.given: a remote access action or administrator intervention occurs
acceptance_criteria.when: the system records the event in its log store
acceptance_criteria.then: an entry exists in the audit log for that activity
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

unresolved_decisions: Which fields must the audit logs contain?
What retention period is required for the audit logs?

requirements.title: provide a centralized dashboard
requirements.statement: The system shall provide a centralized dashboard.

acceptance_criteria.given: a system-controlled user accesses the dashboard named in the source obligation
acceptance_criteria.when: the system opens the source-named dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: the dashboard is displayed or available for use
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: integrate with existing university identity services
requirements.statement: The system shall integrate with existing university identity services.

acceptance_criteria.given: a system-controlled user initiates an exchange with the named external identity service
acceptance_criteria.when: the system performs a controlled interaction with that service
acceptance_criteria.then: interoperation occurs as observed in the source evidence
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: support multiple campus locations
requirements.statement: The system shall support multiple campus locations.

acceptance_criteria.given: a user initiates use from each stated campus location
acceptance_criteria.when: the system supports access from that location
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

assumptions: These are defensive planning hypotheses, not observed incidents or approved extra controls. Unrecognized threats and actual implementation effectiveness require human review.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting User identities and authenticated access: Unauthorized use of a legitimate identity could expose resources or alter system state.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: Derived hypothesis: An attacker uses a compromised identity or authenticated session to impersonate an authorized user and exercise that user's permitted operations.
risks.mitigation: Review impersonation and compromised-identity paths against the stated access duties; confirm any additional identity or session protections with the stakeholder. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting Role and permission boundaries: A lower-privilege user could access restricted functions or sensitive resources.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: Derived hypothesis: A principal exploits an incorrect role assignment or permission check to perform operations outside the source-defined authorization boundary.
risks.mitigation: Test permitted and denied role/resource pairs against the linked authorization duties; review ambiguous permission assignments with the resource owner. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting Access grants and revocations: A formerly authorized principal could continue using access that is no longer approved.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: Derived hypothesis: A revoked or changed permission remains effective in a session or enforcement point, allowing access after authorization should have ended.
risks.mitigation: Trace permission changes through subsequent access decisions and any active access; confirm revocation timing and session semantics before baselining them. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting Monitoring and security alerts: Relevant suspicious activity could remain undetected or receive delayed investigation.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: Derived hypothesis: Suspicious activity evades the source-defined detection workflow, or excessive events obscure actionable alerts before an authorized reviewer can investigate.
risks.mitigation: Evaluate the stated detection duties with representative positive and negative events; confirm undecided thresholds, alert priorities and investigation responsibilities. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting Source-restricted access: An unauthenticated principal could gain access to the restricted resource.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: A principal attempts to reach a source-restricted resource without completing the required authentication. Source boundary: The system should authenticate users before access is granted, enforce role-based access restrictions, detect repeated failed login attempts and unauthorized access attempts, generate security alerts, and maintain audit logs of remote access activity and administrator actions.
risks.mitigation: Review the failure or abuse path against the linked source obligations. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting Integration trust paths: Untrusted integration data could cause incorrect decisions or hide security events.

risks.mitigation: Review trust assumptions at the specified integration boundaries with missing or altered input fixtures; confirm the required failure handling with the owner. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting Security and administrative audit evidence: Investigators could lose reliable evidence of the events required by the brief.

risks.mitigation: Compare source-required events with the resulting audit evidence; assess missing and altered-record cases and confirm unprovided protection or retention decisions. sdlc.justification: The Incremental model is selected based on derived evidence showing the need for integrated security reviews (E-002, E-003), operational validation through monitoring feedback (E-003), staged deployment across multiple locations (E-004) to enable controlled rollout, and integration verification of connected systems (E-004). These factors collectively support a phased, iterative approach that aligns with security assurance, operational feedback loops, and system interoperability. The Incremental model scores highest at 66 points—outperforming Hybrid (65), DevSecOps (63), Spiral (51), and others—with derived strengths in both validation and deployment scope. While the evidence is derived rather than direct, it establishes a consistent need for iterative testing and feedback. The decision remains proposed due to unknown factors including budget, failure consequences, legacy systems, and verification methods; these are not assumed or resolved. No model demonstrates superior performance across all derived criteria, but Incremental best balances security assurance, operational validation, and deployment flexibility within the available evidence.
tradeoffs: Recurring delivery requires stakeholder review and backlog refinement; a cycle does not guarantee completeness or remove unresolved decisions.
Proposed suitability recommendation; confirm delivery constraints and team capacity before adopting this lifecycle. Missing factors are not assumed.
